# DeepSage

> DeepSage teaches real-world skills -- AI literacy, data analysis, critical thinking, and more -- through short articles and interactive quizzes.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://deepsage.com/): what DeepSage is and how it works
- [Articles](https://deepsage.com/article/): full article index
